% Region-coordinate contract fixture: the visible page box is not the MediaBox.
%
% The default MediaBox is [0 0 612 792] (US Letter, points). This sets a
% CropBox whose lower-left corner is (36, 54) -- deliberately not (0, 0) -- so
% the visible page box (CropBox intersected with MediaBox) is
% [36 54 576 756]. Region coordinates must be measured from the top-left of
% that visible box; measuring from the MediaBox instead shifts every crop and
% drops the sentinel line below.
\pdfpageattr{/CropBox [36 54 576 756]}
\begin{document}

\noindent The cropboxsentinel-tango marker sits on the first line of this page.
